z-m-17-03.title: Kuzadza ndiro ine chimiro chebhora, tinoda mvura yendiro yekoni kakawanda sei?
z-m-17-03.topic: Vhoriyamu yebhora: hukama pakati pamavhoriyamu ebhora, koni, nesirinda
z-m-17-03.goal: Fungidzira hukama pakati pamavhoriyamu ebhora, koni, nesirinda usati waverenga, gadzirisa kufungidzira nguva imwe neimwe mugumisiro wekuyera wauya ndokuuronga kuita chiyero chaicho, uye wedzera kuona kuti vhoriyamu inokura kangani kana hurefu hwapetwa kaviri.
z-m-17-03.material: Pane ndiro A ine chimiro chebhora ine radhiyasi 3 cm, ndiro B ine chimiro chekoni ine radhiyasi yechigadziko 3 cm nekureba 6 cm, uye ndiro C ine chimiro chesirinda ine radhiyasi yechigadziko 3 cm nekureba 6 cm. Bhora A rinopinda mukati mesirinda C richibata pamusoro, pazasi, nepadivi chaizvo. Ngatitii hupamhi hwendiro hunofuratirwa uye hapana mvura inodururwa. Ukuru hwendiro hunodzokororwa kutaurwa panhanho yega yega yebasa iri.
z-m-17-03.thinking.0: Kuparadzanisa zvinozivikanwa nechokwadi nezvinongova kufungidzira nezvaunoziva zvino
z-m-17-03.thinking.2: Kungwarira pakuwedzera kubva pakuyera kumwe chete
z-m-17-03.prereq.0: Vhoriyamu yesirinda (nzvimbo yechigadziko × kureba), uye kuti vhoriyamu yekoni ine chigadziko nekureba zvakafanana ihafu yetatu yesirinda
z-m-17-03.prereq.1: Hauna kudikanwa kuziva fomula yevhoriyamu yebhora (inowanikwa mubasa iri)
z-m-17-03.s.s1.prompt: Data inobuda chimwe chidimbu panguva. Panhanho yega yega, sarudza zvaunofunga kuti zvakakodzera zvikuru uchishandisa zvinozivikanwa zvino chete, uye kana data itsva ikauya, enderera kana kugadzirisa kutonga kwako.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.hint.0: Panhanho yega yega, siyanisa zvaunogona kutaura nechokwadi kubva pazvinozivikanwa zvino chete nezvinongova kufungidzira.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.hint.1: Uchitora sirinda C sechiyero, dhirowa kana kufungidzira zvikamu zvinotorwa nebhora A nekoni B, uye uzvienzanise.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Pane ndiro nhatu. A ine chimiro chebhora ine radhiyasi 3 cm, B ine chimiro chekoni ine radhiyasi yechigadziko 3 cm nekureba 6 cm, uye C ine chimiro chesirinda ine radhiyasi yechigadziko 3 cm nekureba 6 cm. Bhora A rinopinda mukati mesirinda C richibata pamusoro, pazasi, nepadivi chaizvo. Hupamhi hwendiro hunofuratirwa uye hapana mvura inodururwa. Vhoriyamu yekoni ine chigadziko nekureba zvakafanana ihafu yetatu yevhoriyamu yesirinda.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unoedza kuzadza A zvizere nekuzadza B nemvura ndokuidira mu A, uchidzokorora. Usati waverenga, unofunga kuti kudira kwangani kunodiwa kuti A izere?
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Bhora A rinopinda mukati mesirinda C uye pane nzvimbo isina chinhu padhuze nemakona, saka unogona kutaura kuti inotora nguva dzisingasvike 3 dzaB, huwandu hunozadza C. Haugone kuziva zvakananga kuti nguva dzingani.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Zvinoita sekuti A ichazara mushure mekudira nguva dzinenge 3, pasina chinoshaya
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakafunga kuti bhora rinozadza sirinda zvizere. Fungidzira zvikamu zvisina chinhu pakati pebhora nemakona esirinda.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zvinoita sekuti kudira nguva dzinopfuura 1 asi dzisingasvike 3 kuchakwana
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakafungidzira kuti iri rakawanda kupfuura ndiro imwe yekoni asi risina kusvika sesirinda. Taura kuti kuenzanisa kunotsigira izvi kwakaita sei.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Zvinoita sekuti kunyange kudira nguva 1 kwakakwana kuizadza
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakaita bhora nekoni sezvakaenzana muukuru. Enzanisa chikamu chimwe nechimwe chinotora mukati mesirinda.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Haizopfuuri nguva 3, asi tinoda kuverenga kuti tiziive nhamba chaiyo yenguva
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wakafunga kuti huwandu hwunozivikanwa asi nhamba chaiyo yenguva inoda kuverenga kana kuyera.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Takayera chaizvo. Patakazadza B nemvura ndokuidira mu A kaviri, A yakazara chaizvo. (Hapana mvura yakadururwa uye ndiro dzinoonekwa dzisina hupamhi.)
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Nzira yakakodzera zvikuru yekugamuchira mugumisiro uyu wekuyera ndeipi?
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Kubva pakuyera, A i2 nguva B uye sirinda C i3 nguva B. Saka A ihafu mbiri dzetatu dzeC. Unogonawo kuongorora nekuverenga. B i18π, A i36π, uye C i54π cm³. Asi, kutaura kuti kuyera kumwe chete kunoshanda kumaukuru ose, unofanira kuongororawo pamaukuru mamwe.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: A i2 nguva B uye C i3 nguva B, saka A ihafu mbiri dzetatu dzeC
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakabatanidza mugumisiro wekuyera nehukama pakati pesirinda nekoni ndokuverenga kunyange hukama pakati pebhora nesirinda.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: A ihafu yeC, nokuti bhora rinopinda sirinda chaizvo
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakanzwa kuti sezvo bhora rinopinda sirinda chaizvo, rinenge rakaita hafu. Enzanisa nechokwadi chekuti pakuyera A i2 nguva B uye C i3 nguva B.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Tinogona kuziva chete kuti A i2 nguva B uye hatigoni kuziva hukama neC
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Hauna kushandisa hukama pakati pesirinda nekoni hwakapihwa pamwe chete nekuyera. Batanidza zvokwadi zviviri izvi.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Takayera nyaya imwe chete, saka tinofanira kuongorora zvakaparadzana kana zvakafanana pamaukuru mamwe
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uku kuita kwekungwarira pakuwedzera kubva pakuyera kumwe chete. Pamwe chete nekutonga uku, unogonawo kutaura hukama hwawawana zvino.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Zvino tinogadzira ndiro dzine hurefu hwose hwakapetwa kaviri. A' ibhora rine radhiyasi 6 cm, uye C' isirinda ine radhiyasi yechigadziko 6 cm nekureba 12 cm. A' inopindawo chaizvo mukati meC'.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Vhoriyamu yeA′ i nguva dzingani vhoriyamu yeA?
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Vhoriyamu yesirinda C' i π×6²×12 = 432π, iyo i8 nguva 54π yeC. A' ihafu mbiri dzetatu dzeC', saka 288π, uye A i36π, saka i8 nguva. Kana hurefu hwapetwa kaviri, upamhi, kudzika, nekureba zvose zvinopetwa kaviri, saka vhoriyamu inova 2×2×2 = 8 nguva.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakafunga kuti kana hurefu hwapetwa kaviri, vhoriyamu inopetwawo kaviri. Enzanisa zvakananga mavhoriyamu esirinda C' neC.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ikukosha kwekuwanza 2 kaviri, sezvinoitwa nenzvimbo. Kune vhoriyamu, mativi ose matatu, upamhi, kudzika, nekureba, anobatanidzwa.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Izvi zvakaverenga kuti mativi ose matatu anopetwa kaviri.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ikukosha kwekuwanza 2 kanhatu. Ongorora kuti unofanira kuwanza mativi mangani.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga waigona kutaura huwandu chete 'dzisingasvike nguva 3,' kubva pakuyera wakaziva hukama 2 : 3, uye pakupedzisira wakafungidzira kuti vhoriyamu inova nguva dzingani kana hurefu hwakakurisa. Tarisa shure kuti kuvimba kupi kwakakura kana kudzikira panhanho yega yega uye humbowo hupi hwakazviita.
z-m-17-03.s.s2.prompt: Sua akati, "Bhora rinopinda chaizvo musirinda, saka vhoriyamu yebhora inofanira kuva hafu yevhoriyamu yesirinda." Ongorora kana izvi zvakarurama uchishandisa migumisiro yekuyera iri pamusoro sehumbowo, uye kana zvisina kururama, nyora kuti zvinofanira kugadziriswa sei.
z-m-17-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kubva mumigumisiro yekuyera, nyora mutsara mumwe pachimwe nechimwe hukama hweA, B, neC se'nguva dzingani.'
z-m-17-03.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga kuti 'hafu' yakataurwa naSua inoenderana nendiro dzingani dzeB uye uienzanise nemugumisiro wekuyera.
z-m-17-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakasimbisa mhinduro yako pamigumisiro yekuyera here (A i2 nguva B, C i3 nguva B)?
z-m-17-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakasiyanisa chikamu chekufungidzira kwaSua chakarurama (bhora rinodiki kupfuura sirinda) nechikamu chisina kururama (hafu) here?
z-m-17-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora zvakajeka here chirevo chakagadziriswa (semuenzaniso, chidimbu) nenhamba?
z-m-17-03.s.s2.model.0: Hazvina kururama. Kudira B kaviri kunozadza A, uye C inotora nguva 3 dzeB, saka A ihafu mbiri dzetatu dzeC. Zvakarurama kuti bhora rinodiki kupfuura sirinda, asi rinopfuura hafu zvakanyanya.
z-m-17-03.s.s2.model.1: A i36π uye C i54π cm³, saka A÷C = 2/3. Kunyange bhora richipinda musirinda chaizvo, makona haana chinhu, saka haizadzi, asi inozadza zvikamu zviviri muzvitatu, kwete hafu. Kufungidzira kwaSua kunoda kugadziriswa.

z-m-17-06.s.s1.prompt: Data inobuda chimwe chidimbu panguva. Panhanho yega yega, sarudza zvaunofunga kuti zvakakodzera zvikuru uchishandisa zvinozivikanwa zvino chete, uye kana data itsva ikauya, enderera kana kugadzirisa kutonga kwako.
z-m-17-06.title: Kana huwandu hwema relative frequencies hwakabuda 0.99, tafura yakaipa here?
z-m-17-06.goal: Dzidza kuti ungatarisa sei kana musiyano wehuwandu hwema relative frequencies kubva ku 1 uri nekuda kwekutenderedza kana kukanganisa chaiko, gadzirisa kutonga nekuva nechokwadi neruzivo rutsva, uye ugadzire tafura iwe pachako apo huwandu hwakasiyana nekuda kwekutenderedza.
z-m-17-06.material: Mutafura ye frequency distribution, huwandu hwema relative frequencies i 1. Zvisinei, mutafura apo ma relative frequencies akanyorwa akatenderedzwa, huwandu hunogona kusiyana zvishoma ne 1. Mubasa iri, ma relative frequencies akanyorwa akatenderedzwa kunzvimbo mbiri dze decimal.
z-m-17-06.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kutonga nekuva nechokwadi kuti zvienderane neruzivo rutsva
z-m-17-06.thinking.2: Kugadzira matafura akati wandei anogutsa mamiriro
z-m-17-06.prereq.1: Relative frequency = frequency yeclass ÷ total frequency
z-m-17-06.prereq.2: Maitiro ekutenderedza kunzvimbo mbiri dze decimal
z-m-17-06.s.s1.hint.0: Pachinhanho chimwe nechimwe, nyora zvakasiyana zvawatarisa kare nezvausati watarisa.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga kuti musiyano unogadzirwa nekutenderedza mutengo mumwe wakakura sei kuenzanisa nehukuru hwemusiyano mukuwedzera.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.info:
Kuvadzidzi 30, tafura ye frequency distribution yakagadzirwa nekupatsanura nhamba yemabhuku akaverengwa muvhiki rimwe kuita makirasi matatu, uye relative frequency yekirasi imwe neimwe (frequency yekirasi iyoyo ÷ total frequency) yakanyorwa yakatenderedzwa kunzvimbo mbiri dze decimal.
Kirasi / Frequency / Relative frequency
Mabhuku 0 kana kupfuura, shoma kupfuura mabhuku 2 / vadzidzi 10 / 0.33
Mabhuku 2 kana kupfuura, shoma kupfuura mabhuku 4 / vadzidzi 10 / 0.33
Mabhuku 4 kana kupfuura, shoma kupfuura mabhuku 6 / vadzidzi 10 / 0.33
Huwandu / vadzidzi 30 / 0.99
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.ask: Relative frequency iri muserosero rehuwandu i 0.99, kwete 1. Uchatora sei tafura iyi zvino?
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.after: Kubva pachokwadi chekuti huwandu husiri 1 bedzi, haugone kutaura kuti yakaipa kana kuti zvakanaka. Unofanira kutarisa kuti yasiyana nekuda kwechikonzero chipi.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Pangave nekukanganisa kuverenga, saka verenga zvakare ma frequencies nema relative frequencies uye utarise
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Iyi i maitiro ekutarisazve chikamu chaunokahadzika. Zvauchatonga mushure mekutarisa ndizvo zvakakosha.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Musiyano ungabva mukutenderedza, saka ongorora mitengo zvakananga
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Iyi i maitiro ekuramba wakazarura kuti pangasava nechikonzero chimwe chete uye kutarisa.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Huwandu hwema relative frequencies hunofanira kuva 1, saka tafura iyi, isiri 1, i tafura yakaipa
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Chimiro chekuti huwandu i 1 chinoenderana nemitengo isati yatenderedzwa. Verenga kana chichishanda sezvachakaita pamitengo yakadzikiswa kusvika kunzvimbo mbiri dze decimal.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Musiyano we 0.01 i mudiki zvikuru, saka nyora zvakare huwandu se 1.00 usina kutarisa
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kana ukachigadzirisa usingazivi kuti nei kunyangwe musiyano muduku wakamuka, haugone kusiyanisa kukanganisa chaiko nemusiyano wekutenderedza.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.info: Pakutarisa, ma frequencies aiva 10, 10, 10, uye huwandu hwawo hwakaenzana nevadzidzi vese 30. Relative frequency imwe neimwe i 10÷30 = 0.3333..., uye yakanyorwa yakatenderedzwa kunzvimbo mbiri dze decimal se 0.33. Zvese zviri pasi penzvimbo yechitatu ye decimal zvakarasirwa.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uchiona mhedzisiro iyi yekutarisa, kutonga kwakakodzera zvikuru nezvetafura iyi i kupi?
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana ukapfupisa 0.3333... panzvimbo yechitatu ye decimal, mitengo yese mitatu inova diki zvishoma, saka huwandu i 0.99. Musiyano wakadai uri nekuda kwekutenderedza, kwete nekuti tafura yakaipa. Pane zvakare nzira yekugadzirisa mutengo kuti huwandu hwuve 1, asi zvakadaro unofanira kutaura kuti wakagadzirisa.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Kuverenga kwakarurama. Huwandu hwakava 0.99 nekuda kwemusiyano wekurasa zvese zviri pasi penzvimbo yechitatu ye decimal
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakatonga nekubatanidza mhedzisiro yekutarisa kuverenga nemhedzisiro yekutenderedza.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kunyangwe kuverenga kwakarurama, kana huwandu husiri 1 i tafura yakaipa, saka ma frequencies anofanira kugadzwazve
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakaiona sekuti yakaipa kunyangwe kuverenga kwakarurama. Funga kuti unowana chii kana ukapfupisa 0.3333... uye ukaiwedzera katatu.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kuverenga kwakarurama. Unogona kunyora mutengo mumwe se 0.34 kuti huwandu hwuve 1, asi taura kuti wakagadzirisa
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakafunga nezvechokwadi chekuti pane nzira yekuita kuti huwandu hwuenderane uye kuti panguva iyoyo unofanira kutaura.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Chinja ma frequencies kuita sa 10, 10, 11 kuti huwandu hwuswedere padyo ne 1
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Frequency i mhedzisiro yekuverenga vadzidzi. Haufanire kuchinja data kuti huwandu hwetafura huenderane.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Pane tafura yeimwe boka. Vadzidzi vese 30 vakapatsanurwa kuita makirasi mana, uye ma frequencies akanyorwa se 4, 6, 8, 15. Relative frequency imwe neimwe yakanyorwa yakatenderedzwa kunzvimbo mbiri dze decimal se 0.13, 0.20, 0.27, 0.50, uye 1.10 yakanyorwa muserosero rehuwandu.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kutonga kwakakodzera zvikuru nezvehuwandu hwe 1.10 mutafura iyi i kupi?
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Huwandu hwema frequencies i 4+6+8+15 = 33, iyo yakasiyana nevadzidzi vese 30. Kutenderedza mutengo mumwe kunochinja nechinenge 0.005 pakanyanya, saka huwandu hwemitengo mana hunogona kusiyana nechinenge 0.02 pakanyanya. 1.10 i yakakura kupfuura izvozvo, saka hazvisi kutenderedza; ma frequencies kana nhamba yese yevadzidzi hazvina kururama.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.o.a: I musiyano unokonzerwa nekutenderedza, sezvakaita tafura yakapfuura, saka tafura iyi inotorwawo setafura yakarurama
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakaiona sechikonzero chakafanana netafura yakapfuura. Enzanisa kana musiyano uyu uri wehukuru hwakafanana nemusiyano wakapfuura.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Pane makirasi mana ose, saka misiyano yekutenderedza bedzi inogona kuita kuti huwandu hwuve 1.10
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Zvakarurama kuti zvikanganiso zvekutenderedza zvinogona kuunganidzana muhuwandu. Asi enzanisa nekuti musiyano wemutengo mumwe uri mudiki sei.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Musiyano wekutenderedza hauzogoni kupa 0.10, saka tarisa kana huwandu hwema frequencies i 30
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakaenzanisa hukuru hwemusiyano nekukanganisa kwekutenderedza uye wakasarudza kwekutarisa.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Kunyangwe huwandu husiri 1, zvakanaka chero ma relative frequencies ese akarurama, saka usatambudzika nehuwandu hwuri muserosero
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Kutonga uku kunosiya ruzivo runopiwa nemutengo uri muserosero rehuwandu. Funga kuti chii chingaitika kana huwandu hwakasiyana zvikuru.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.reflect: Chinhu chimwechete, huwandu husiri 1, dzimwe nguva chinokonzerwa nekutenderedza uye dzimwe nguva kukanganisa chaiko. Tarisa kumashure kuti wakavasiyanisa here nekutarisa kana hukuru hwemusiyano huri hwemhando inogona kutsanangurwa nekutenderedza uye kana huwandu hwema frequencies huchienderana nehuwandu hwese.
z-m-17-06.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza ma frequencies (a, b, c) emakirasi matatu ane total frequency 30, uye ugadzire matafura 3 akasiyana apo, kana relative frequency imwe neimwe yatenderedzwa kunzvimbo mbiri dze decimal ikawedzerwa, huwandu husiri 1.00. z-m-17-02.topic: Saizi yemakona nema units: kona inoumbwa nemaoko ewachi
z-m-17-02.goal: Tsvaga uye ugadzirise mutsara wakashata mumhinduro yekona inoumbwa nemaoko ewachi, uye utsanangure kuti kana maoko ose maviri achifamba, nzvimbo yeoko rimwe nerimwe inofanira kusetwa zvakaparadzana kuti ienderane nenguva.
z-m-17-02.material:
Pachiso chewachi ye analog, nhamba 12 dzakaiswa pamikaha yakaenzana, uye makona anoyerwa clockwise kubva panzira ye12 o'clock. Wachi yakarurama uye oko rimwe nerimwe rinotenderera nekukurumidza kwakagara. Oko re hour rinotenderera kamwe mumaawa 12, uye oko re minute rinotenderera kamwe mumaminetsi 60. Minjae akaedza kutsvaga kona inoumbwa neoko re hour neoko re minute pa3:20 (diki pamakona maviri) ndokugadzirisa sezvizvi pazasi.
1) Kutenderera kamwe kwakazara kwewachi ndi360° uye pane nhamba 12, saka nzvimbo imwe yenhamba ndi30°.
2) Oko re minute rinotenderera kamwe mumaminetsi 60, saka rinofamba 6° paminetsi, uye pamaminetsi 20 riri 120° kubva panzira ye12 o'clock.
3) Oko re hour rinongedza ku3, saka riri 90° kubva panzira ye12 o'clock.
4) Kona pakati pemaoko maviri ndi120° − 90° = 30°.
5) Saka kona inoumbwa neoko re hour neoko re minute pa3:20 ndi30°.

z-m-17-02.thinking.1: Kutsvaga mutsara wakashata uye kutsvaga mhedzisiro zvakare nekukosha kwakagadziriswa

z-m-17-02.s.s1.hint.1: Dhirowa awachi pa3 o'clock chaizvo neawachi pa3:20, uye uenzanise kuti nzvimbo dzemaoko dzakatsanangurwa mumutsara wega wega dzinoenderana nemufananidzo upi pamaviri.
z-m-17-02.s.s1.line.0: Kutenderera kumwe kwakazara kweawachi i360° uye pane nhamba 12, saka nzvimbo imwe yenhamba i30°.
z-m-17-02.s.s1.line.1: Ruoko rwemaminitsi runotenderera kamwe mumaminitsi 60, saka runofamba 6° paminitsi imwe, uye pamaminitsi 20 ri120° kubva kunzira ye12 o'clock.
z-m-17-02.s.s1.line.2: Ruoko rweawa runongedza ku3, saka ri90° kubva kunzira ye12 o'clock.
z-m-17-02.s.s1.line.3: Kona riri pakati pemaoko maviri i120° − 90° = 30°.
z-m-17-02.s.s1.line.4: Saka kona rinogadzirwa neruoko rweawa neruoko rwemaminitsi pa3:20 i30°.
z-m-17-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 hauna kururama. Pa3:20 ruoko rweawa harugari panzvimbo ye3 o'clock; apo ruoko rwemaminitsi runotenderera kwemaminitsi 20, rwafambawo shoma. Ruoko rweawa runotenderera kamwe (360°) muawa 12, saka runofamba 30° paawa, uye mumaminitsi 20 runofamba 10° yakawanda, saka ri100° kubva kunzira ye12 o'clock. Mitsara 4 ne5 inoshandisa kukosha kwemutsara 3 sezvakaita, saka kuverenga kwayo kwakarurama asi mugumisiro unochinja.
z-m-17-02.s.s2.prompt: Kana ukagadzirisa mhinduro yaMinjae nenzira yakarurama, kona diki rinogadzirwa neruoko rweawa neruoko rwemaminitsi pa3:20 i madhigirii mangani?
z-m-17-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga washanda kona rinofambwa neruoko rweawa paawa imwe (maminitsi 60).
z-m-17-02.s.s2.hint.1: Shandisa kukosha kwacho kuwana kona rakafambwa neruoko rweawa mumaminitsi 20, nyora zvakare nzvimbo yeruoko rweawa, uye uienzanise nenzvimbo yeruoko rwemaminitsi.
z-m-17-02.s.s2.r.a: Wakaverenga semhinduro kona chete (10°) rakafambwa neruoko rweawa mumaminitsi 20 ekuwedzera. Kona riri pakati pemaoko maviri ikukosha kunowanikwa nekuenzanisa nzvimbo dzeruoko rweawa neruoko rwemaminitsi.
z-m-17-02.s.s2.r.b: Wakaenzanisa zvakare nzvimbo dzemaoko maviri, uchisanganisira kuti ruoko rweawa rwakafamba zvakawanda sei mumaminitsi 20.
z-m-17-02.s.s2.r.c: Wakatora mhinduro yekutanga sezvayakaita, iyo yaiona ruoko rweawa sechigara panzvimbo ye3 o'clock.
z-m-17-02.s.s2.r.d: Wakaverenga nzvimbo yeruoko rweawa (kona kubva kunzira ye12 o'clock) sekona riri pakati pemaoko maviri. Unoda kukosha kunowanikwa nekuenzanisa nenzvimbo yeruoko rwemaminitsi.
z-m-17-02.s.s2.explain: Ruoko rweawa ruri pa100° uye ruoko rwemaminitsi ruri pa120°, saka kona riri pakati pemaoko maviri i20°. Senzira imwe, unogona kushandisa chokwadi chekuti ruoko rwemaminitsi runofamba 5.5° paminitsi nekukurumidza kupfuura ruoko rweawa uye uwane kukosha kumwe chete (pa3 o'clock ruoko rwemaminitsi ruri 90° shure kweruoko rweawa, uye mumaminitsi 20 runodzamisa 110°, saka riri 20° mberi).

z-m-17-07.topic: Mean, median, range: kana ma scores akachinjwa nemutemo wakatarwa
z-m-17-07.goal: Dzidza kuti mitengo yekumirira nekupararira zvinochinja sei kana mitengo yese ikachinjwa nekuwedzera nhamba imwechete kana kuwanza nenhamba imwechete, uye ugadzire iwe pachako mitemo yekugadzirisa inogutsa mamiriro uye uienzanise.
z-m-17-07.material: Bvunzo yeyuniti yemath yakanga yakaoma, saka mean yakabuda yakaderera. Mudzidzisi anoda kugadzirisa ma scores evadzidzi vese nemutemo mumwechete. Ma scores ekutanga evadzidzi 7 i 35, 50, 55, 55, 65, 70, 90 points, uye mean i 60 points, median i 55 points, mode i 55 points, uye musiyano pakati pe score yepamusoro neyepasi i 55 points. Score yakagadziriswa inowanikwa se 'score yekutanga × p + q' (p i nhamba hombe kupfuura 0), uye score haigoni kupfuura 100 points.
